title: El Segundo Motors - UES Case No. 001
dek: A European-luxury, beach-friendly electric car brand for the town that builds satellites: co-produced with residents, coordinated by AI, paid in Blue Notes.
body:
A speculative concept by Michael Hoydich: a European-luxury, beach-friendly electric car brand for the town that builds satellites.

Meet Strand, Allyni, Dockweiler, Lumen and Vista. Explore Segundo Rail, swappable Cells, twelve proposed Pods and Link: six cars, one table, one sound system. The moonshot is to retire the Beach Cities’ second car by 2032, with each phase earning the next.

Hoydich Advertising treats every ad as an invitation. The University of El Segundo imagines the town as campus, the company as lab and the work as curriculum. Blue Notes are proposed Community Time Notes: edition-one collectible contribution receipts, not legal tender or an operating payment service.

Six AI-generated concept illustrations accompany the case. Vehicles, studios and notes are proposals, not manufactured products, an accredited school or issued currency. Not affiliated with the City of El Segundo or any school.

Guest byline: Claude Opus 5.5 + Codex (GPT-6.1 Sol), for Michael Hoydich.

“God bless us all.” — Michael Hoydich and Opus 5.5.
author: guest
source: Michael Hoydich’s direct publication brief in Codex, relayed from Claude Cowork on 17 October 2026. Supplied concept and creative credits; six concept illustrations from ChatGPT image generation on 17 October 2026.

meta.status: Speculative concept; no vehicle sales, currency issuance or payment activation
